article.headline: McGhie's 27 help UC San Diego knock off San Diego 77-71
article.description: — Tyler McGhie scored 27 points as UC San Diego beat San Diego 77-71 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: McGhie's 27 help UC San Diego knock off San Diego 77-71
article.story: SAN DIEGO -- — Tyler McGhie scored 27 points as UC San Diego beat San Diego 77-71 on Saturday night. McGhie went 9 of 20 from the field (7 for 10 from 3-point range) for the Tritons (11-2). Aniwaniwa Tait-Jones scored 17 points while shooting 5 of 8 from the field and 7 for 7 from the free-throw line and added six assists. Hayden Gray had 11 points and shot 4 of 8 from the field and 3 for 4 from the foul line. The Tritons prolonged their winning streak to nine games. Joey Chammaa led the Toreros (3-9) in scoring, finishing with 14 points. Santiago Trouet added nine points and 20 rebounds for San Diego. Bendji Pierre also recorded nine points. UCSD went into halftime leading San Diego 32-28. Gray scored nine points in the half. McGhie scored 19 points down the stretch in the second half to help lead UCSD to a six-point victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
